note: City of Trinidad's Monument Lake, a mile-long spring-fed lake in the Sangre de Cristos, run as a resort by a concessionaire on CO-12 (Highway of Legends) west of Weston, with lodge rooms, adobe cabins, a restaurant, marina and boat rentals beside the campground. Full-hookup sites sit back in the trees, partial-hookup sites on the hillside above Cherry Creek, and primitive tent-or-RV spaces along the lake and creek. --Claude

flags: Phone: the operator's site gives 719-680-0580 (Contact Us; registration office 7 am - 4 pm); the entry has 719-868-2226. Suggest 719-680-0580.
Website: the first stored link is the FareHarbor booking embed; the operator's own site is https://themonumentlakeresort.com/ - make it the website (FareHarbor is now booking.url).

Mandatory resort pass: every camping reservation 'must have a daily or annual resort pass for the length of your stay' - $6 per vehicle per day ($12 with a trailer), $45 annual. With it a one-night primitive stay is about $53.70-59.70. Local-government ownership, so no price gate.

Waterfront (stored lakeview) - contrary claim, re-audit lead (not changed): the operator says the primitive sites 'boast both Lakeside and Creekside camping. Whether you're camped out along the lake ...', while the partial-hookup sites are 'on the mountain side just above Cherry Creek' and the full hookups 'back in the trees'. FareHarbor gives no site coordinates. On imagery the stored pin is at the lodge complex just below the dam at the lake's south end; the primitive RV spaces along the west-shore road could be lakefront, while the hookup sites below the dam would have no lake value (below-the-dam rule). A site map is needed to split them.
Length: two primitive spaces are short (#23 '21Ft. Trailer' max, #42 '20 FT. Max'), and partial #72 is a 25-ft trailer only; most RV sites take 25 ft or more, so EKKO fits.
